info.name: Gainsight CS Timeline Activities API
info.description:
The Timeline API enables creating, updating, reading, and deleting Timeline activities, supporting both single and bulk operations with up to 80MB payloads for bulk requests.

Contact Support:
 Name: Gainsight Support
 Email: support@gainsight.com

request.description: Create multiple activities in a single request. Supports payloads up to 80MB.
